in_sanskrit.name: काम्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who fulfills or grants the desire or passion

in_marathi.name: Kaamya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaamya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Desire, Wish-fulfilling; Kaamya is the name of the goddess of desire in Hindu mythology. She is also known as Kamakshi, the goddess with the lotus eyes that can grant desires. The name Kaamya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kama', meaning desire.
